definitions.explanation: A feeling of sorrow and concern for the suffering or misfortune of others. Can carry a slightly condescending nuance depending on context.

examples.english: I was looked at with eyes of pity.
One should have mercy even toward enemies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{憐|あわ}れみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{込|こ}み{上|あ}げて→込み上げる：10335_komiageru⟧きた。
examples.english: Listening to her story, a feeling of compassion welled up inside me.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as ⟦{哀|あわ}れみ→哀れむ：11995_awaremu⟧, though {憐|あわ}れみ is more common when emphasizing compassion toward someone's suffering. When used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at with eyes of pity), it often implies a condescending feeling that the recipient may not welcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {憐|あわ}れみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel pity)
- {憐|あわ}れみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eyes of pity)
- {憐|あわ}れみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乞|こ}う→乞う：28921_kou⟧ (to beg for mercy)
- {憐|あわ}れみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have compassion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同情|どうじょう}→同情：11954_doujou⟧: sympathy — more neutral, less condescending
- ⟦{慈悲|じひ}→慈悲：10889_jihi⟧: mercy, benevolence — Buddhist/religious tone, more elevated
- ⟦{思|おも}いやり→思いやり：06651_omoiyari⟧: consideration, thoughtfulness — warmer, without the pity nuance
